mechanism: Bumetanide causes volume and electrolyte depletion which enhances captopril's hypotensive effects, while captopril may reduce renal perfusion and impair bumetanide's diuretic efficacy, creating mutual potentiation of effects and increased risk of hyperkalemia and renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, serum potassium, and adjust diuretic dose as needed; counsel patient on orthostatic hypotension and dehydration symptoms; assess renal function baseline and periodically.
